name: jev-skill-typeahead
description: Shows, while you type, the skills and subagents Claude will probably call for your prompt: reads the draft on every edit and lists them in the band above the prompt, ranked by keyword match (English or Spanish). When you pause, Jev (TypeSafe's decision model) decides which one will be called and the band marks it. Slash commands are left out, since you run those yourself. Without a Jev key it stays on the instant local match.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Key for TypeSafe's own API; preferred over the Gateway since it reports a calibrated confidence

gatewayApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway API key
gatewayApiKey.description: Key for the AI Gateway; with no key at all the band stays on the keyword match

provider.title: Decision backend
provider.description: "auto" picks TypeSafe, then the Gateway, then keywords; "builtin" asks Claude Code's own small model once per pause; "keywords" never decides

typesafeBaseUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
typesafeBaseUrl.description: Empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai. Whatever is set here receives your key and your draft

gatewayBaseUrl.title: AI Gateway base URL
gatewayBaseUrl.description: Empty uses https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v4/ai. Whatever is set here receives your key and your draft

language.title: Band language
language.description: Language of the band's labels; matching understands both

maxRows.title: Rows
maxRows.description: How many skills the band lists (1 to 8; values outside are clamped)

pauseMs.title: Pause before deciding (ms)
pauseMs.description: How long the draft must sit still before Jev is asked (minimum 150)

minWords.title: Words before suggesting
minWords.description: Content words a prose draft needs before the band appears (minimum 1; a draft of 24+ characters also qualifies)

includeSubagents.title: Include subagents
includeSubagents.description: Also suggest the subagent types the engine offers the model (seen once the first prompt of the session has gone out)

timeoutMs.title: Decision timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Jev before the band falls back to the keyword match (minimum 500)

gateThreshold.title: Needs-a-skill threshold
gateThreshold.description: Mean of the gate answers under which no skill is expected to be used

confidenceThreshold.title: Confidence threshold
confidenceThreshold.description: Probability the top skill needs when the backend reports one

attach.title: Tell the model
attach.description: Name the skill the band marked as used to the model, for exactly the text you submit; turn off when jev-skill-suggestion is installed (it would say the same thing twice)

neverSuggested.title: Never suggested
neverSuggested.description: Comma-separated skill names left out of the band

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write each decision to the transcript (one line per decision, off by default)
